page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.2xlarge is a burstable instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture supports instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core. There is no local storage or GPU hardware bundled with this instance, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data shows a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 10%, indicating poor single-threaded execution speeds. However, multi-core benchmarks, such as Geekbench multi-core and Passmark CPU tests, reach average levels within the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests also demonstrate average performance, though Passmark database operations and memory scores are weaker, landing in the bottom 25%.

Given its burstable CPU allocation and lack of dedicated local storage, this instance offers a cost-effective profile for workloads with variable CPU utilization. It is suited for applications that experience periodic spikes in demand rather than sustained high-compute requirements. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, where it achieves average throughput, Redis caching, and general-purpose development or testing environments that do not require continuous high-performance single-threaded execution.
